text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: sudden spike in 504/timeouts at edge gateway. 5m error rate = 8.9% (baseline 0.3%). Traces show increases across /v1/generate and /v1/stream. Paging oncall: <@maria>

maria: seeing it, I'm looking at the dashboard now. can someone grab traces from the last 10m?

jay_sre: on it. pulling flame charts and tailing proxy logs. suspecting upstream timeouts to model backend.

antony: adding context—we had a canary deploy 30m ago for quad-optimizations. Not sure if it's related.

maria: good catch, @antony. can we pin traffic to previous model variant as a rollback option?

samir: I can toggle routing in the gateway. preparing command: `kubectl patch svc edge-router -p '{"spec": {"traffic": {"stable": "v1.2.1"}}}'` — will not run until we confirm.

jay_sre: logs show a lot of `upstream connect timeout` from envoy -> model-proxy-0/1. Examples:
```
[2026-03-14T18:12:03Z] envoy: upstream connect timeout, downstream: 10.0.5.23:443, cluster: model-inference
[2026-03-14T18:12:04Z] model-proxy-1: ksched queue depth 120 -> rejection
```

laura_p: latency heatmap in Grafana — region eu-west1 is first to spike, then us-east-1. errors correlated with high queue depth on model-inference pool.

maria: let's follow the incident runbook: 1) page (done) 2) identify customer impact 3) mitigation 4) postmortem plan.

antony: customer impact: we already have 3 enterprise customers reporting increased latencies via support. Their traffic is mostly routed through eu-west.

samir: starting a short-term mitigation: scale model-inference pool by +2 replicas for eu-west1. running: `k scale deployment/model-inference-eu --replicas=6`

deploy-bot: Deployment model-inference-eu scaled from 4 to 6 replicas (triggered by samir).

jay_sre: after scaling, observing slight drop in queue depth but error rate still elevated ~4.5%. digging into model-proxy logs for 502 vs timeout breakdown.

maria: can we disable the new canary routing as test? if the canary is causing slower kernels with longer start times, that would explain the timeouts.

antony: canary was at 10% traffic. I can flip it to 0%. command: `redwood route set canary --weight 0 --service model-vq-quad`

antony: done — canary weight set to 0%.

jay_sre: after canary drain, error rate falling to 1.2% over 3m window. Looks promising.

maria: nice. keep monitoring for at least 20m. set incident severity and notify support.

samir: created incident ticket INC-2026-317 in JIRA and updated PagerDuty with current mitigation steps.

laura_p: I'm capturing metrics for an initial RCA: p95 latency, 5xx count, queue length, and kernel init time for the canary variant.

maria: good. do we want a quick hotfix to ensure canary doesn't roll out automatically until more tests?

antony: yes — disabling auto-rollout in the deployment config and adding an explicit gating step. I'll push a small config change: `git commit -m "disable auto-rollout for quad-opt canary"` then `git push` and we can trigger a config apply.

deploy-bot: Config change pushed to repo infra/model-routing. CI passed; applying change to staging.

jay_sre: monitoring customers: support ticket for customer ACME shows 504s between 18:10-18:30 UTC. I added transaction ids for traceability.

maria: thanks. let's do an on-call handoff in 25m. @jay_sre can you take first responder for the next shift? I'll remain as incident lead for the postmortem.

jay_sre: I can take it. I'll stay on the thread.

samir: action items I'm tracking live: 
- rollback canary (done)
- scale eu-west inference (done)
- create incident ticket INC-2026-317 (done)
- notify support and customers (samir -> in progress)

maria: Support notified via the support channel and templated email (sent). customers told we're mitigating and will follow up with RCA.

laura_p: follow-up note: we should tune the alert that paged us. current alert: `edge_5xx_rate > 1% for 5m` — too sensitive during normal noise. Suggest change to `>2% for 10m` with multi-region aggregation.

jay_sre: agree. also add an alert for `model-proxy queue depth > 80` and an automated autoscale action for that metric. I'll draft changes.

antony: for immediate hotfix: add a health probe tolerance to model-proxy so transient kernel init doesn't mark connections as failed. small PR in flight.

maria: can you attach the PR link when ready and note the rollback gating in the runbook? we need runbook updates: how to drain canary, scale replicas, update support messages, and alert tuning.

antony: PR: https://git.redwood/infer/infra/pulls/412 — adds probe tolerance and disables auto-rollout flag.

deploy-bot: PR 412 merged to main and deployed to prod-config (user: antony).

jay_sre: monitoring shows error rate back to baseline 0.4% after PR and rollback. I'll leave synthetic tests running for 2 hours.

maria: wrap up:
- Incident severity: Sev2 (brief customer impact, mitigated).
- Root cause (prelim): canary release introduced slower kernel initialization leading to connector timeouts under load.
- Immediate fixes: rollback canary, scale pool, tweak health probes (PR 412).
- Follow-ups: update runbook (action item assigned to laura_p), tune alerts (jay_sre), add canary gating tests in CI (antony), notify customers with RCA (maria).

laura_p: I'll update runbook section `edge-timeout-response` with step-by-step commands, add example `kubectl` and `redwood route` commands, and include a checklist for notifying customers.

samir: logging a short-term RCA summary in INC-2026-317 and tagging all action items.

maria: thanks everyone. keeping thread open for a final postmortem draft in 24-48 hours. marking this thread as resolved for live mitigation. :white_check_mark:

jay_sre: acknowledged, staying on postmortem.

antony: will add CI canary tests and link to PR in the PM doc.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-317 transitioned to status: mitigated (auto-update).

maria: closing the live paging — any further issues, ping SRE channel.

jay_sre: last check 30m after mitigation: stable. moving to monitoring-only.
